Creators in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya often face barriers that prevent them from reaching international buyers. The truth is, geographic limitations can be dismantled with the right technological infrastructure, empowering African creators to sell their digital goods effectively and efficiently. This post outlines a minimum viable stack that works without relying on conventional payment systems, providing a clear path forward for those ready to act.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can establish a fully operational online store that accepts crypto payments without intermediaries. Leverage tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. By choosing blockchain payments, you eliminate the pitfalls of traditional finance that often block creators in Africa. With infrastructure sovereignty, you own your store and data, allowing you to focus on scaling your digital products globally.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack, priced at $97, is your launchpad. It includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This stack supports three products and is deployed within 48 hours. Alternatively, consider the Edge Commerce Stack for a more robust solution, featuring Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, allowing for five products and enhanced security measures. Both stacks equip you to bypass traditional payment barriers completely.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on deployment without getting bogged down by unnecessary prerequisites. You don't need to worry about advanced marketing strategies or complex product designs at the outset. Instead, prioritize setting up a basic store structure with the tools provided. Ensure that your payment system is operational and that your products are ready for delivery. This streamlined approach allows you to start selling immediately while laying the groundwork for future enhancements.
Blockchain payments empower creators to bypass traditional financial barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To process your first transaction, set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your online store. Choose a cryptocurrency like USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds at a minimal fee of under $0.10. This setup ensures that you can efficiently process payments from international buyers without the constraints of local banking systems. Once your store is active, promote your products through social media and local communities to generate initial sales.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, take decisive action. First, purchase and deploy your chosen stack, starting with the Sovereign Starter Stack to get online fast. Then, create your product listings and upload your digital files for immediate delivery. Next, set up your NOWPayments account and test the payment process. Lastly, share your store link within your network to attract your first customers. Follow these steps diligently to build momentum.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by utilizing blockchain technology. By integrating payment solutions like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, you can bypass conventional payment barriers. This allows for quick, secure transactions without the need for accounts or KYC processes, empowering you to reach a global audience.
Own your infrastructure and stop renting your digital store.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack to kickstart your online store. 2. Deploy your stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Set up your product listings with descriptions and digital files. 4. Create an account on NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Test your payment process with a small transaction. 6. Share your store link to attract initial customers.
